high_level_description: This image is a selfie taken indoors on June 10, 2017, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. The photo appears to be part of a collection titled "Best of June 2017." There are two individuals in the photo: a man and a woman. The man is on the left side of the frame, wearing a sleeveless gray top. He has short hair and a beard. The woman is on the right side, leaning her head on the man's shoulder. She is wearing a patterned dress with black and white designs and has dark hair.
